subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When an engineering-side session finds that a requirement in an open feature draft is wrong, missing, or unbuildable, the system shall record a requirement problem against that requirement and leave the requirement unchanged.
rationale: Design flags, product rules; the PRD and tech spec never quietly disagree (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-9)
fit_criterion: A fixture tech-spec session reporting a requirement defect produces one requirement problem naming the requirement, whose text stays byte-identical.
